name: TimePicker

props.name: disabled
props.description: Specify whether the `<input>` should be disabled

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Specify whether you want the underlying label to be visually hidden

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Specify an optional className to be applied to the `<input>` node

props.name: invalid
props.description: Specify whether the control is currently invalid

props.name: invalidText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in an invalid state

props.name: labelText
props.description: Provide the text that will be read by a screen reader when visiting this control

props.name: light
props.description: The `light` prop for `TimePicker` has been deprecated. It will be removed in v12. Use the `Layer` component instead.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Specify the maximum length of the time string in `<input>`

props.name: pattern
props.description: Specify the regular expression working as the pattern of the time string in `<input>`

props.name: pickerClassName
props.description: Specify an optional className to be applied to the container that wraps the `<input>` and select option

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Specify the placeholder attribute for the `<input>`

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Specify whether the TimePicker should be read-only

props.name: size
props.description: Specify the size of the Time Picker.

props.name: warningText
props.description: Provide the text that is displayed when the control is in an warning state

a11y.note: Carbon ships a11y behaviour per component; verify per screen

when_to_use: Use Carbon TimePicker rather than building one.
when_not_to_use: Do not restyle off-token — propose a token instead.
